description:
Salted Malted Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Ice Cream 🍪🍦

In this video, I’m making a Salt & Straws salted malted chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream, using their ingredients (almost 😅 ) and a few smart techniques to get maximum flavour and ultra-creamy texture at home.

Malted milk powder adds depth and body, salt sharpens the chocolate without making the ice cream taste salty, and the cookie dough is designed to stay soft and scoopable straight from the freezer. No complicated steps — just solid ice cream science made easy.

If you like bold flavours, smooth texture, and recipes that actually work in a home freezer, this one’s for you.
